item.title: Tonstudio Gress Elevates Immersive Audio with Genelec-Powered Dolby Atmos Room
item.description: In the historic Bad Cannstatt district of Stuttgart, Tonstudio Gress is setting new benchmarks for immersive audio production. The facility, founded by brothers Alexander and Raymond Gress in 1989, has unveiled a state-of-the-art 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos control room built around Genelec’s acclaimed 8000 Series monitors, delivering precise localisation, clarity, and creative flexibility for a diverse range of projects. item.title: Rob Papen Launches WirePluck
item.description: Renowned Dutch sound designer and plugin developer Rob Papen has unveiled WirePluck, a brand-new virtual instrument plugin that brings a fresh and futuristic edge to the world of plucked string synthesis. Available now for PC and Mac, WirePluck blends physical modeling synthesis with subtractive synthesis and analog-style filtering, delivering a rich palette of timbres ideal for modern music production. item.description: Watford Colosseum officially reopened its doors on Friday 29 August, welcoming fans back with a powerhouse performance from Ocean Colour Scene and marking the start of a new era for the historic venue. item.title: Epiphone Unveils Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom
item.description: Epiphone has announced the release of the Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom, a meticulous recreation of Joe Bonamassa’s famed “Black Beauty” — his rare 1959 Gibson Les Paul Custom guitar. Developed in close collaboration with the blues-rock virtuoso himself, the new model celebrates one of Bonamassa’s most cherished instruments while bringing vintage character to a modern audience. item.title: PhantomFocus and ATC at Nashville’s Canyon Studios East
item.description: Don Miggs' Canyon Studios East has recently renovated its facility featuring the PhantomFocus™ System (PFS) monitor tuning protocol and ATC monitors in both its A & B PhantomFocus MixRooms. item.title: JBL VTX and Crown power Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
item.description: For more than two decades, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony has relied on a consistent audio philosophy: high-impact musical delivery combined with uncompromising speech intelligibility. That approach continued in 2025, as a full JBL Professional VTX system, powered by Crown Audio, supported the five-hour live ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. item.title: Audio-Technica ATH-R70xa receives TEC Award Recognition at NAMM 2026
item.description: Audio-Technica’s ATH-R70xa open-back reference headphones have been honoured with a Technical Excellence and Creativity Award in the Headphone and Earpiece Technology category at the 41st Annual TEC Awards, presented during the 2026 NAMM Show in Anaheim, California. item.title: Tommy Torres highlights the importance of honest monitoring in music production
item.description: Latin Grammy-winning producer and songwriter Tommy Torres has spoken about the importance of accurate monitoring and midrange clarity in his creative workflow, citing KRK studio monitors as a key component of his Miami-based production setup.
